fields.description: Hillviews is a residential and retail development in Dubai Science Park, with studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments around a large podium-level leisure setting. Its curved plan produces different indoor and balcony proportions. Original design counts and floor schedules are kept separate from present inventory and construction status.

overview: The outdoor area can be a substantial share of the quoted total. Compare the suite column and the precise balcony shape before treating two same-bedroom plans as equivalent.
research.locationNote: Dubai Science Park, Dubai. The development’s view and road-access descriptions do not guarantee an individual apartment’s outlook or commute.
research.priceNote: The own project hero displays FROM AED 800,000. A separate official studio page references AED 853,000 and 426 sq ft; Property Finder retains AED 824,000 as a launch reference. These apply to different published bases, not interchangeable live offers.
research.paymentNote: The own FAQ states 20% down payment, 50% during construction and 30% on completion, also shown by Property Finder. No current dated payment sheet was retrieved. Confirm fees, instalment deadlines and any outstanding developer balance in the selected unit’s agreement.
research.handoverNote: The developer’s current FAQ targets Q4 2026. Property Finder instead retains April 2026, already elapsed. The source difference is disclosed rather than selecting a precise month; no actual completion or key handover is established by the retrieved documents.

facts.value: 1,552 homes: 688 studios, 757 one-bedroom and 107 two-bedroom apartments; 19 ground-floor shops. Not available inventory.

facts.label: Floor schedule discrepancy
facts.value: Own facts specify 35 residential floors, with two basements, ground, four podiums, one mechanical room and roof. The own FAQ instead says 37 residential floors; confirm the approved selected-unit floor plan.

unresolved: A dated primary construction measurement and actual handover notice were not retrieved. Do not infer progress from the calendar or rendered imagery.

Service charges, selected parking allocation, furnishings and current available units remain unverified. Published total sizes include balconies and vary by type; the signed apartment area statement takes precedence.
